location.description: Azure location/region (optional - retrieved from storage account properties if not provided)

resource_id.description: Full Azure resource ID (optional - will be built from subscription_id, resource_group, resource_name if not provided)

group_by_metadata.$comment: Common values: ApiName (recommended for transactions), OperationName, Tier (recommended for blob capacity). Required when filter_metadata_values or metadata_aggregation is defined.
group_by_metadata.description: Optional metadata key for grouping metrics. Common values: ApiName (recommended for transactions), OperationName, Tier (recommended for blob capacity). Applies to all metrics unless overridden per metric. Required when filter_metadata_values or metadata_aggregation is defined.

filter_metadata_values.$comment: Can only be defined when group_by_metadata is defined. Array of metadata values to filter by (e.g., ['Blob', 'Table']).
filter_metadata_values.description: Optional array of metadata values to filter by (e.g., ['Blob', 'Table']) - applies to all metrics unless overridden per metric. Can only be defined when group_by_metadata is defined.

service_name.description: Service name that will be returned in CheckMK response

time_range.description: ISO 8601 duration format used for both time range and granularity (e.g., PT1H, PT5M)

aggregation.$comment: Available values: average, sum, count, min, max
aggregation.description: Aggregation type applied to all metrics unless overridden. Recommended: 'average' for capacity (bytes), 'sum' for transactions (count).

metadata_aggregation.$comment: Available values: average, sum, count, min, max. Can only be defined when group_by_metadata is defined.
metadata_aggregation.description: Aggregation type for combining grouped metadata values. If not specified, defaults to 'aggregation' field. Applies to all metrics unless overridden per metric. Can only be defined when group_by_metadata is defined.

type.description: Metric type identifier. 'capacity': Unit is bytes, recommended aggregation is 'average'. 'transactions': Unit is count, recommended aggregation is 'sum', recommended group_by_metadata is 'ApiName'.

time_range.description: Optional override for common time_range (used for both time range and granularity)

aggregation.$comment: Available values: average, sum, count, min, max
aggregation.description: Optional override for common aggregation. Recommended: 'average' for capacity (bytes), 'sum' for transactions (count).

metadata_aggregation.$comment: Available values: average, sum, count, min, max. Can only be defined when group_by_metadata is defined.
metadata_aggregation.description: Optional override for common metadata_aggregation. If not specified, falls back to metric-level aggregation, then root-level metadata_aggregation, then root-level aggregation. Can only be defined when group_by_metadata is defined.

scope.$comment: Available values: account, Blob, Table, Queue, File
scope.description: Scope for metrics. Use 'Blob' for blob storage metrics, 'Table' for table storage metrics, 'account' for account-level aggregation.

group_by_metadata.$comment: Common values: ApiName (recommended for transactions), OperationName, Tier (recommended for blob capacity). Required when filter_metadata_values or metadata_aggregation is defined.
group_by_metadata.description: Optional metadata key for grouping (overrides root-level group_by_metadata if specified). Common values: ApiName (recommended for transactions), OperationName, Tier (recommended for blob capacity). Required when filter_metadata_values or metadata_aggregation is defined.

filter_metadata_values.$comment: Can only be defined when group_by_metadata is defined. Array of metadata values to filter by (overrides root-level filter_metadata_values if specified).
filter_metadata_values.description: Optional array of metadata values to filter by (overrides root-level filter_metadata_values if specified). Can only be defined when group_by_metadata is defined.
